content: UI pure-logic tests: bun test cannot load UI tsx modules that use @/ alias unless the nearest tsconfig has a paths block — src/ui/tsconfig.json now mirrors tsconfig.app.json's mapping. Keep pure derivation logic in <component>-logic.ts files so tests cover them without a DOM; loading a 0%-covered tsx into bun test drags the repo-wide coverage floors below the ratchet. Extensions need 'bun run ext:install' locally or their tests fail on missing deps.
